sections.title: The Russian letter и
paragraphs: The letter is named (и) /i/. Its main sound is heard in (игра) /ɪˈɡra/, which means game, play. This vowel makes three sounds in Russian speech. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: For the first sound, spread your lips wide. Push your tongue high and forward in your mouth. For the second sound, relax your tongue slightly down and toward the centre. For the third sound, pull your tongue back into the middle of the mouth. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake for all three sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: A stressed syllable is one that you say with more strength. When the letter is stressed, say /i/ as in (мир) /mʲir/. In an unstressed syllable, say /ɪ/ as in (зима) /zʲɪˈma/. After the letters ж, ш or ц, say /ɨ/ as in (жить) /ʐɨtʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the stressed sound into a diphthong. A diphthong is two vowel sounds in one syllable. Keep your tongue steady, unlike the moving vowel in English see. For the sound after hard letters, do not say the vowel in English sit. Push your tongue further back inside your mouth.
